jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager - PMO (all genders)
jobs.description:
Your creative field

We are looking for a full-time, permanent Technical Project Manager (all genders) to join our PMO team as soon as possible. We embrace a remote-first approach (within Germany), but you can choose whether you’d like to work in a hybrid model or entirely on-site, depending on your proximity to one of our locations (Berlin, Hamburg, Cologne, Munich).


As a Senior Technical Project Manager, you are a cornerstone of strategy execution at Contabo – and you're joining at a time when a lot is moving strategically. Alongside the continued evolution of our existing cloud infrastructure, we are driving initiatives that will expand our portfolio well beyond what exists today over the coming years. This is exactly where your role comes in: embedded in our PMO, you take end-to-end ownership of technical projects across development teams and business functions – including initiatives for which no blueprint exists yet, where you help shape structures from the ground up.

You work at the intersection of technology and business: you translate sometimes still ambiguous requirements into executable plans, actively challenge requirements, and structure initiatives into scalable roadmaps, iterations, and implementation phases. In your day-to-day work, you coordinate priorities, dependencies, and delivery sequencing across multiple teams and parallel workstreams, identify resource bottlenecks and delivery risks early, and ensure transparency through structured reporting, clear governance, and effective escalation management – especially when scope and priorities shift in our fast-moving environment. You'll be working with tools like Jira, Confluence, and comparable solutions.

Beyond individual projects, you shape the PMO itself: you continuously develop our standards and processes, support portfolio alignment and prioritisation, and share your knowledge as a mentor to junior project managers. A lean PMO at Contabo means a high degree of autonomy and genuine ownership – you report directly to the Head of Strategy Execution & ESG and contribute measurably to the execution of Contabo's strategic roadmap.


What convinces us

Your personality, paired with:

  • 5+ years of experience in technical project or program management within software development or technical delivery organisations
  • Proven end-to-end delivery ownership of cross-functional initiatives with multiple parallel workstreams – not limited to governance or status-reporting roles
  • Strong experience in stakeholder and escalation management
  • A high degree of ownership and composure in an environment of shifting priorities and ambiguity
  • Confident use of common PM tooling such as Jira, Confluence (or comparable)
  • Experience in a cloud, hosting, or IT infrastructure environment, as well as with agile scaling, PMO, or portfolio management (a plus)
  • A completed degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Engineering, or a comparable qualification
  • Professional fluency in English; German language skills and certifications (PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, PSM) are a plus

We know that you may not currently meet all of these requirements. But if you bring the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm for the role, we can achieve great things together.


Awesome Prospects

At Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference.

What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint.

Additionally, we offer:

  • Work the way that fits your life – Remote or hybrid with flexible hours for a healthy work-life balance and the same technical equipment at home as in the office
  • Experience real freedom – Workation across the EU and in our summer office in Mallorca
  • Stay active and healthy – Access to EGYM Wellpass and thousands of fitness and wellness facilities
  • Enjoy exclusive perks – Attractive discounts on many products and services through our corporate benefits program
  • Recharge your energy – 30 days of vacation plus additional days off on Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve
  • Give back – An extra day off to get involved in social activities through our Volunteer Day
  • Make an impact – Take ownership and bring your ideas to life with real creative freedom
  • Keep growing – Individual professional and personal development opportunities in an innovative tech environment
  • Feel comfortable where you work – Modern, conveniently located offices across our European locations
  • Be part of a diverse team – Work in an international environment shaped by diversity
  • Create lasting memories – Company events and team activities you won’t forget


How to reach us

If you have any questions, you can reach out to Max by email at .

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (ISR) Defence & Intelligence (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager (ISR) (f/m/x) to own the product and delivery side of LiveEO's defence and intelligence business. Sektion 4 builds AI-based ISR capabilities for German and allied defence and intelligence customers: object and change detection in very high resolution satellite imagery, 3D terrain products derived from stereo imagery, and the analytics that turn imagery into decisions. You will run our customer-facing defence products end to end from a product management perspective including analytical products as well as end user applications. You will also build the roadmap that connects different customer timelines, our concept of operations and the actual maturity of our technical components into one plan that engineering and sales both work from. This role exists because our LiveEO engineers build world class AI models and your work will help to bring them into operations and roll them out to many more end users. We need someone who can say how an analyst does the job, write requirements a military user would recognise, and hold the line on what we ship.

LiveEO is a dynamic team that thrives on big challenges and fast learning cycles. We move quickly, stay curious, and genuinely enjoy building together. We are on a mission to break the "curse of Earth Observation": turning incredible satellite data into reliable, actionable decisions that people can trust and use in real operations on scale. 

You will be part of Sektion 4, LiveEO's government-solutions product team. Sektion 4 owns its roadmap and delivers funded R&D projects and defence engagements end-to-end, from research through to production, and sets its own technical direction. You will work day to day with the team's ML engineergs, full-stack engineers and geospatial data egineers, and across LiveEO with sales, pre-sales and the teams building the Twinspector satellite programme. Externally you are in front of military and agency users, partners and integrators, in workshops, requirement sessions and user tests.


Tech stack & tools:
  • Linear (backlog, sprints)
  • Confluence
  • Google Workspace 
  • LiveEO's own ISR and analytics applications
  • Figma 
  • QGIS and comparable viewers
  • STAC-based imagery catalogs Data:
  • very high resolution optical imagery
  • synthetic aperture radar
  • 3D surface models 
  • cloud and secure on-premise / air-gapped deployments
  • agentic tools for a variety of work.


Your challenge

As Product Manager (f/m/x), you own what we build for defence and intelligence customers, and you are accountable for it reaching them.

  • Own the ISR product: take our imagery intelligence application from working demonstrator to deployable product. Define the release scope, the deployment and support model for secure on-premise environments, and drive the first installation at a real user.

  • Run the backlog: work with the engineering team in two-week sprints. Translate operational needs into written requirements and user stories, prioritise ruthlessly, cut scope when it is the right call, and keep the team pointed at what matters.

  • Deliver defence projects end to end: own scope, milestones, deliverables and stakeholder communication for our customer-facing defence engagements, and take on new projects as the pipeline converts.

  • Build and maintain the roadmap: reconcile project timelines, our concept of operations and component readiness into one roadmap that is used to set priorities, not to describe them afterwards.

  • Be the ISR authority in the team: bring operational depth on the intelligence cycle, collection and tasking, and imagery exploitation. Be the person engineering asks how an analyst would really use this, and the person sales asks what we can credibly claim.

  • Work with users and customers: run workshops and user sessions, gather and structure feedback, demonstrate the product, and support bids and proposals with operational substance.


Your profile

  • Professional ISR, GEOINT or IMINT background: Bundeswehr, the intelligence community, defence procurement, or an ISR role in industry.

  • Real operational fluency in the intelligence cycle, collection and tasking, and how imagery products are produced and consumed at a staff.

  • Proven ability to translate operational needs into written requirements that engineers can build from. Track record of driving work to a deadline across dependencies you did not control.

  • German at native or fully fluent level, and professional English.

  • German or European citizenship and eligibility to obtain a German security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung). 

  • Willingness to work on-site in Berlin, hybrid with at least two days per week in the office, and to travel within Germany to customers and users.

  • You take ownership and proactively push work forward. 

  • You communicate clearly and collaborate smoothly within and across teams.

  • Pragmatic mindset: you balance operational ambition with what can actually be shipped.

  • You enjoy working with complexity and turning ambiguity into structure.

  • Product management or product ownership experience: backlog, sprint cadence, release scoping is a plus.

  • Project management experience in defence or publicly funded programmes (national, EU, NATO) is a plus.

  • Experience writing CONOPS, operational requirements or capability documents is a plus.

  • Familiarity with satellite imagery, remote sensing, or AI and machine learning products is a plus.

  • Experience delivering software into secure on-premise or air-gapped environments is a plus.

  • An existing valid German security clearance (SÜ2 / SÜ3) is a plus.

  • Working knowledge of NATO standards and interoperability for imagery and geospatial data is a plus.


Your Benefits

  • The opportunity to create a product that can improve business processes and lives across the globe.

  • Flexible working hours and hybrid work model - we trust our employees to get their work done while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

  • We empower employees to drive their own career development, take initiative and have the freedom to be creative and bold.

  • Not an overtime culture - we take care that overtime is done only as a necessity and always offset with time off and rest.

  • A collaborative and learning environment - frequent internal workshops, knowledge sharing sessions, journal clubs and hackathons.

  • Office located in the centre of Berlin Kreuzberg with free fruit, nuts and drinks.

  • Potential to participate in the employee stock option program.

  • Urban Sports membership and BVG subsidy, corporate pension program.

  • A diverse and vibrant international environment of 30+ different nationalities

Tandem is the leading global language learning community, with over 35 million members from all around the world practicing languages together. The concept of learning from each other is not only core to the Tandem community, it is also at the heart of how we work every day at Tandem.


We are based in Berlin, profitable and growing, and backed by top European investors. We are highly international and driven by a shared passion for languages, technology, and culture. We are looking for a bright, data-driven, collaborative operator to help us improve the experience of our members. 


Your role will be to:

  • Run the experiment loop: hypothesis, spec, launch, readout, ship or kill. Keep a steady cadence of live tests.

  • Find the next bets from data, research, and member feedback - not from a backlog of random ideas.

  • Spec and land a small number of features with design and engineering; you are accountable for the outcome, not the ticket.

Senior Technical Project Manager (all genders)

Thorit GmbH · Böblingen, Germany · Hybrid · Full-time · Available immediately

About the Role

You will own delivery for our software projects end to end: HubSpot CMS builds, custom development, system integrations, and AI agent engineering for enterprise B2B clients. You sit inside the Engineering team, not next to it, which means you baseline the project, defend the estimate, run the delivery rhythm, and stay the single accountable person from kickoff to handover. If you are technical enough to argue with an engineer and commercial enough to negotiate scope with a client, this is that seat.

What You'll Do

  • Own scope, budget, and timeline for a portfolio of software and agent engineering projects, from baseline to go-live.

  • Baseline every project properly: person-day estimates, milestones, dependencies, and a live risk log in Jira, Confluence, and Forecast.

  • Run one clear weekly delivery rhythm across the Engineering team: sprint reviews, risk reviews, change control, and a status pack clients actually read.

  • Protect the margin by catching scope drift early and turning it into signed Change Requests instead of unbilled work.

  • Challenge estimates. You will push back on both optimistic and padded numbers, and build an estimation model the team can reuse.

  • Lead distributed engineering squads across Böblingen and Lisbon without formal authority over them.

  • Automate your own reporting with AI tooling, so status packs take minutes rather than half a day.

What You Bring

Must-haves

  • 5+ years running software delivery projects (web platforms, custom development, or integrations) in an agency, consultancy, or product organisation.

  • Demonstrable ownership of budget and scope, not just timeline coordination. You can talk through a project's numbers, not only its Gantt chart.

  • Enough technical depth to read an API contract, a data model, or a pull request and hold your own with senior engineers.

  • Experience negotiating scope changes with client stakeholders and converting them into commercial agreements.

  • German at business level (client steering committees run in German) plus fluent English (engineering work runs in English).

  • Comfort in a distributed setup with colleagues in two countries.

Nice-to-haves

  • Hands-on exposure to HubSpot CMS, HubSpot APIs, or a comparable platform ecosystem.

  • Experience with AI-assisted delivery work, agent workflows, or LLM tooling in a delivery context.

  • A background that started technical (development, QA, solution engineering) before moving into delivery management.

Your Team

You will report to the Practice Lead Development & Technology and join the Development Team inside Thorit's Development & Technology Practice, alongside software engineers, AI engineers, technical consultants, and UX designers across Böblingen and Lisbon. The Team Lead Development seat is currently open, so you will work directly with the Practice Lead and have unusual room to shape how software delivery runs here. You will also work closely with the PMO Practice, which owns delivery method across the company.

Tech Stack

HubSpot (CMS, custom modules, APIs), Jira, Confluence, Forecast, Claude and Claude Code, GitHub and GitHub Actions, MCP-based agent tooling, Miro, Figma for design handover.

What We Offer

  • 30 vacation days per year, plus Baden-Württemberg public holidays on top.

  • Hybrid working from our Böblingen HQ, in a team that is genuinely used to distributed collaboration.

jobs.title: Associate Product Owner
jobs.description:
TL;DR

Full-time. Berlin-based. No remote option available for this role. You sit with the PM.

Join GlassDollar as an Associate Product Owner and own the space between a good idea and a shipped feature.
Someone has to decide what "done" means, write it down clearly enough that an engineer can start on Monday, and stay close enough to the build that the scope does not quietly grow on the way. That is the job. You own it end to end: specs, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and a backlog that keeps everyone honest about what is actually shipping. Nobody hands you a ticket queue you did not write yourself.

The problem you'll be solvingA corporation with 100,000 employees has thousands of expensive operational problems, and somewhere out there a startup has already solved most of them. Getting those two facts to meet is slow, political, and mostly attempted in spreadsheets that die in someone's downloads folder.
GlassDollar OS is the venture clienting platform that makes it repeatable: sourcing the startups, matching them to real problems, running the pilots, and rolling out what works across the whole organisation. Enterprise customers run real innovation budgets through it. What you scope this month decides what they can do next quarter.


What we're looking for

You have personally written the tickets.
3+ years in a product company, where scoping and ticket-writing were actually your job rather than something you handed off.
You are technical enough to argue with engineers.
AI models, API contracts, estimates, sequencing. You push back with reasons, and you change your mind when the reasons coming back are better.
You can write.
A spec is a piece of writing. We will ask for a sample where the reasoning is visible, polish second.
You write specs worth acting on.
The valuable ones pull three threads together: where the product is going, what clients are actually telling us, and the knowledge already sitting in the team. You gather all three before you write, so what lands on the board is specific enough to build and pointed enough to matter.
You know what looks good.
You have a great sense of design and what feels good for users. We will ask you to build a prototype with AI and illustrate the specs visually.
You have worked somewhere small enough that there was nowhere to hide.
No layers between you and the consequences of a bad spec.
You want to be coached hard.
Direct feedback, weekly, on your actual work. You will scope alongside the product lead until you are doing it alone, and the goal is that this happens fast.
You are fluent with AI tooling, day to day.
We want to see the workflow, not hear it described.
You want the scope to grow.
The people who do best here end up owning areas outright: the major initiatives, the roadmap arguments, and the questions everyone else brings their doubts to. That is earned, and it is genuinely available.


What you'll do

Your job: turn validated opportunities into work an engineer can start on Monday.

  • Turning opportunities into scoped, sequenced, estimable work: specs, acceptance criteria, edge cases, dependencies
  • Running the backlog: grooming, prioritisation input, keeping the board honest about what is in flight, blocked, or quietly drifting
  • Being the interface between customer signal (support threads, CS conversations, call notes) and the engineering queue
  • Coordinating releases and checking that what shipped matches what was scoped
  • Presenting product decisions to varied stakeholder groups, from engineers to enterprise clients

What you'll be scoping over your first year:
  • Deep integrations into our customers' organisations. Their systems, their data, their identity stack. This is the work that turns GlassDollar from a tool people visit into infrastructure they run on.
  • Public REST APIs and MCP servers, so our customers' engineers and their AI agents can build on top of us.
  • AI embedded across the product, inside the surfaces people already work in.
  • Workflow automation inside the platform, so the work that used to take six meetings and a shared spreadsheet runs itself.
You will need to understand each of these well enough to write the spec and defend it in the room.
This is a doing role rather than a people-management one. Mid-to-senior individual contributor.


Requirements

  • 3+ years in a product company, where you personally wrote the tickets
  • Technical enough to understand a data model, an API contract, and estimation
  • Demonstrable writing ability, be ready to share a spec, PRD or decision doc
Nice to have:
  • B2B enterprise SaaS background
  • Familiarity with venture clienting, corporate innovation, or startup-scouting workflows
  • Notion fluency

Don't check every box? Apply anyway. We care more about the questions you ask about a brief than the answer you land on.


How we hire

Straightforward. Respectful of your time. No mystery steps.

  1. Intro call: a quick chat to see if there's a match
  2. Interview with the PM, including a brief introduction to the work sample: a spec, PRD, or decision doc where your reasoning is visible, plus examples of problems you've framed
  3. Interview
  4. Offer: if it clicks, we don't wait around

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
Your mission

The future of construction software isn't a single closed platform — it's a connected ecosystem. As our Technical Product Manager for Integrations, you'll own how Cosuno connects to the third-party systems our customers already rely on, from estimating and ERP tools like RIB iTWO to the open REST API that lets others build on top of us. You'll be the bridge between our customers, our engineers, and our platform — turning real-world integration needs into a roadmap that makes Cosuno the infrastructure the construction industry plugs into.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role in our Product team. Both our REST API and our connectors are still early, so you won't just maintain an integration surface — you'll shape it. You'll spend real time on-site with customers, understand how their systems actually work, and translate that into a product that lets them connect to Cosuno as seamlessly as possible.

In your first few months, you might:

  • Take ownership of our integrations product area — the REST API and our existing connectors to third-party systems such as RIB iTWO — and define where they go next.

  • Travel to customers across Germany to support them hands-on with implementing and setting up connectors, and to understand their systems, data flows, and constraints in the real world.

  • Sit down with customers to elicit integration requirements, then prioritize them against impact, effort, and our platform strategy.

  • Translate those requirements into clear, well-scoped tickets that our engineers can pick up and build — with the technical context they need to move fast.

  • Work through our API documentation and test endpoints yourself to validate what's possible, spot gaps, and represent the developer experience from the outside in.

  • Partner with Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales to make sure customers can connect their systems to Cosuno with as little friction as possible.

How we work

At Cosuno, we give people real ownership and trust them to do their best work. For this role, that means:

  • High autonomy, high impact: You'll own the integrations area end to end. No one will look over your shoulder, but you'll always have the support of the Product and Engineering teams when you need it.

  • Close to the customer: This is not a desk-only PM role. A meaningful part of your time is spent with customers on-site.

  • Technical by nature: You'll work directly with APIs, documentation, and connector behavior. You don't have to ship production code, but you do need to be comfortable in technical territory.

  • Platform thinking: We're building the infrastructure other construction tools and AI agents connect into. Every integration decision feeds that bigger picture.

  • AI-first: We use AI deeply in both our product and our daily work, and we want people who do the same.

Your profile

You'll be a great fit if you have:

  • 3–5 years of experience in product management, ideally in B2B SaaS, platform, or developer-facing products.

  • Hands-on experience with APIs and integrations — you understand how REST APIs work, can read and reason about API documentation, and are comfortable validating endpoints (e.g. with tools like Postman) yourself.

  • A talent for working directly with customers: eliciting requirements, asking the right questions, and earning trust in technical conversations.

  • The ability to translate messy, real-world integration needs into prioritized, well-scoped tickets that engineers can act on.

  • Strong analytical thinking and a pragmatic instinct for turning complex problems into workable solutions.

  • Fluent German (this is a firm requirement — all of our customers are German construction companies and you'll work with them directly and on-site) and fluent English.

  • Willingness to travel regularly to customers within Germany.

  • You use AI tools — LLM-based assistants, MCPs, no-code prototyping — routinely in your day-to-day work.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with construction tech, ERP, or estimating systems (e.g. RIB iTWO, SAP, Nevaris).

  • A background as a solutions engineer, integration engineer, or technical consultant before or alongside product management.

Why us?

  • Competitive Compensation: A competitive salary above the market average.

  • Work-Life Balance: Work fully remotely from anywhere in Germany, or from our modern office in Berlin Friedrichshain. We offer flexible working hours to fit your life.

  • Top-Notch Equipment: A new MacBook Pro to ensure you have the best tools for the job.

  • A Great Team: Regular company off-sites and team events that connect us as people, not just colleagues.

  • Job Security: A permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.

  • Growth & Feedback: An open feedback culture with regular 1:1s and development conversations.

About us

Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology.

We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity.

Artificial intelligence is the key to our solution: it analyzes millions of price data points and helps construction companies create precise and efficient bids. This not only saves our customers time but also helps them avoid unnecessary costs.

But for us, it's not just about technology – it's about the people who drive it. At Cosuno, you will work with creative minds who are reshaping the construction industry. We believe in diversity because we know that the best ideas come from different perspectives. An integrative and inclusive work environment is a matter of course for us.

Join us – Build the future of construction.

jobs.title: Product Manager AI Search (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Unser Projekt für Dich:

moebel.de ist eines der führenden Online-Shoppingportale für Möbel und Einrichtung in Europa. Unser neues Projekt Piqit ist ein KI-gestützter Shopping-Assistant, der die Art und Weise verändert, wie Menschen online Produkte finden und kaufen.

Piqit berät den Nutzer interaktiv und findet passende Produkte aus über 100 Millionen Angeboten, vergleicht Preise über zahlreiche Shops hinweg und führt direkt zum passenden Anbieter – von Wein und Werkzeug über Elektronik und Haushaltsgeräte bis hin zu Beauty, Schmuck und Möbeln. 

Dafür suchen wir dich als Product Manager AI Search (m/w/d).


Deine zukünftigen Aufgaben

  • Vom ersten Tag an mittendrin statt nur dabei: Du verantwortest die Antwortqualität von Piqit, unserem KI-gestützten Shopping-Assistant, der aus über 100 Millionen Angeboten das passende Produkt findet – und zwar von der ersten Beobachtung bis zur ausgerollten Änderung.
  • Qualität heißt hier nicht Treffermenge, sondern Antwort: Du prüfst, ob Piqit verstanden hat, worum es geht, ob die vorgeschlagenen Produkte wirklich die richtigen sind und ob die Einordnung dazu trägt.
  • Ursachenforschung ist deine Kerndisziplin: Wenn eine Antwort nicht überzeugt, unterscheidest du sicher, ob die passenden Produkte gar nicht gefunden wurden, ob in den Produktdaten ein Attribut fehlt oder falsch belegt ist oder ob das Modell aus guten Daten etwas Falsches gemacht hat.
  • Du kennst die Eigenheiten von Sprachmodellen: stark bei Absicht, Nuance und Sprache, unzuverlässig bei exakten Zahlen, Vollständigkeit und Aktualität – und dabei immer überzeugend klingend. Genau dieses Gespür bringst du in jede Entscheidung ein.
  • Hands-on statt Konzeptpapier: Prompt-Sets, Hints und Regeln schreibst und rollst du selbst aus, Attribute und Facetten schärfst du selbst nach, Testsets baust du selbst – und wiederkehrende Handgriffe automatisierst du weg, gern KI-gestützt.
  • Du misst, was wirkt: Einzelfälle sind kein Beleg, dieselbe Anfrage kann zweimal unterschiedlich beantwortet werden. Du prüfst gegen eine feste Sammlung von Testanfragen und bewertest die Veränderung über alle hinweg. Der Weg von der Beobachtung zur Änderung ist kurz, vieles geht am selben Tag live.
  • Du bist Sparringspartner:in für Data und Engineering: Für Themen, die tiefer in der Pipeline liegen, arbeitest du eng mit den Fachbereichen zusammen. Was du nicht selbst umsetzen kannst, übersetzt du in fundierte Anforderungen an Engineering und Data – mit Beispielen, Zahlen und einer klaren Priorisierung.
  • Neue Shops, neue Daten: Du begleitest die Partneranbindung, prüfst, was die Antwortqualität wirklich trägt, und sagst klar, wenn ein Sortiment noch nicht live gehen sollte.
  • Kategorie-Management ist dein Schlüssel: Kategorien, Attribute und Facetten entscheiden mit darüber, was der Assistent über ein Produkt überhaupt weiß – und weil semantische Ähnlichkeit allein nicht reicht, sobald es um Maße, Kompatibilität oder harte Grenzen geht, legst du hier selbst mit Hand an.


Deine Stärken

  • Du kannst relevante Berufserfahrung im E-Commerce, im Produktmanagement oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle vorweisen, in der du ein Produkt wirklich vorangetrieben und nicht nur begleitet hast
  • Eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität zeichnet dich aus – du willst Dinge selbst bauen und live sehen, statt sie zu delegieren und nachzuhalten
  • Mit Sprachmodellen hast du über gelegentliches Prompting hinaus praktisch gearbeitet: Du hast Prompts systematisch verbessert, Ergebnisse verglichen und weißt, wo diese Systeme kippen – idealerweise mit Lösungen wie Claude, ChatGPT oder Gemini
  • Durch dein Gespür für Nutzerbedürfnisse erkennst du, was hinter einer Anfrage steckt und wann eine Antwort nur oberflächlich passt
  • Du überzeugst durch eine selbstständige, ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise und hast Lust, deine Ideen aktiv im Team einzubringen
  • Technisch bist du anschlussfähig: Du liest eine API-Antwort, verstehst eine Datenstruktur und hast keine Scheu vor SQL – programmieren musst du nicht, selbst anpacken schon
  • Erfahrung mit Retrieval, Ranking oder semantischer Suche sowie mit dem Aufbau von Evals und Testsets ist wünschenswert
  • Kenntnisse in Produktdaten, Feeds, Taxonomien und Attributsystemen sind von Vorteil, ebenso Erfahrung mit Automatisierungsplattformen wie n8n, Make oder Python sowie mit MCP- und Agenten-Anbindungen
  • Deutsch beherrschst du verhandlungssicher, gute Englischkenntnisse bringst du mit


Unser Angebot

Dein Tagesablauf gehört dir
Arbeite dann, wenn du am produktivsten bist. Ob Früh- oder Spätaufsteher: Bei uns passt du deine Arbeitszeiten flexibel an – in enger Abstimmung mit deinem Team. Zeitweise Arbeiten aus dem europäischen Ausland? Kein Problem. Dein Laptop ist dein Arbeitsplatz.

Unsere Kultur ist einmalig
Hier sitzen alle auf derselben Couch – unabhängig von Titel oder Rolle. Teamspirit leben wir digital und vor Ort, z. B. bei Gaming Nights, Workouts, Filmabenden oder Teamevents.

Viermal im Jahr treffen wir uns zur Company Week
Gemeinsam im Büro arbeiten, Projekte pushen, Pizzabende genießen und mit einer Party abschließen.

Mitten in Hamburg
Zentral gelegen zwischen Hauptbahnhof, Mönckebergstraße und Binnenalster – perfekt für Lunch-Dates, Pausen an der Alster oder einen Feierabendbummel.

jobs.title: Manager, Account Management, SME & Growth, France
jobs.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

The opportunity

We are looking for a Manager, Account Management, France to lead and develop a team of four Account Managers responsible for retaining, supporting and expanding Airwallex’s French customer base.

This is a highly hands-on player-coach role. You will own the team’s post-sale operating model across Onboard, Adopt, Prove Value and Expand, while remaining directly involved in strategic accounts, customer escalations, onboarding quality and expansion opportunities.

You will work closely with Sales, Onboarding, Support, KYC, Risk, Product and Operations to improve customer outcomes and make Airwallex easier to adopt and grow in France.

What you’ll do

Lead and coach the team

  • Manage and develop four Account Managers through focused 1:1s, account reviews, call coaching and development plans.

  • Set clear standards for account planning, stakeholder coverage, customer communication, CRM hygiene and commercial execution.

  • Improve individual performance through real customer situations, not activity reporting alone.

  • Build a team that can operate with increasing autonomy and consistent judgement.

Own customer outcomes and portfolio strategy

  • Segment the portfolio by customer value, complexity, risk and expansion potential.

  • Define the right coverage model: high-touch for strategic and high-potential accounts, more scaled motions for lower-complexity accounts.

  • Ensure priority customers have clear success outcomes, stakeholder maps, adoption plans and expansion hypotheses.

  • Improve the leading indicators of NRR: onboarding progress, time-to-value, product adoption, stakeholder coverage, customer health and expansion pipeline.

  • Improve the lagging outcomes: retention, GRR, NRR, satisfaction and advocacy.

Drive expansion and account growth

  • Build a repeatable, customer-led expansion motion across accounts, payments, FX, cards, Spend, payouts and related products.

  • Ensure expansion is based on validated customer needs, business triggers and demonstrated value—not product pitching alone.

  • Personally support strategic renewals, upsells, cross-sells and executive customer conversations.

  • Partner with Sales on handovers, pre-sales support and opportunities requiring specialist or new-business involvement.

Build the operating system

  • Create practical playbooks for onboarding, adoption, customer health, level 2 support, renewal and expansion.

  • Establish weekly reviews for risks, strategic accounts, escalations and expansion opportunities.

  • Improve visibility and predictability through clear CRM standards, account plans, health reviews and forecasting.

  • Build a closed-loop Voice of Customer process with Product, Operations, KYC, Risk and Support.

  • Turn recurring customer friction into process improvements rather than repeated individual escalations.

Orchestrate complex customer issues

  • Own the customer-facing coordination of important level 2 issues involving Support, KYC, Risk, Product or Operations.

  • Structure escalations with clear context, business impact, owner, next step and customer communication.

  • Influence internal teams to find workable solutions without bypassing controls or making unsupported commitments.

This role owns customer outcomes and orchestration. It is not a support queue-management role, and it does not replace the specialised ownership of Support, KYC, Risk or Compliance.

What success looks like

Within 90 days, you have mapped the portfolios, priority accounts, risks and expansion opportunities; established the team cadence; and created visibility on the main customer and operational issues.

Within 6–12 months:

  • priority accounts have clear plans, stakeholder coverage and next-best actions;

  • onboarding, adoption, escalation and expansion playbooks are consistently used;

  • leading indicators such as time-to-value, adoption, health coverage and expansion pipeline improve;

  • GRR, NRR, customer satisfaction and retention improve against an agreed baseline;

  • recurring customer issues are reduced through better processes and cross-functional ownership;

  • the four Account Managers show stronger autonomy, commercial judgement and consistency.

Who you are

  • 5+ years in Account Management, Customer Success, Sales, Expansion or a related B2B commercial role.

  • 2+ years of direct people management, ideally leading a team of 3–8.

  • Proven ownership of retention, renewals, expansion, adoption, customer health or comparable outcomes.

  • Experience working with NRR, GRR, churn, expansion, adoption, time-to-value or customer satisfaction metrics.

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, payments, banking, FX, spend management, ERP or another complex operational environment.

  • Strong customer-facing experience with Finance, Operations, Treasury, Procurement, E-commerce, founders or senior executives.

  • Evidence of building or improving customer processes, playbooks, account segmentation, health reviews, handovers or escalation routines.

  • Ability to influence Support, KYC, Risk, Product and Operations without direct authority.

  • Fluent French and professional English.

  • Strong commercial judgement, ownership and comfort working in ambiguity.

Preferred experience

  • Payments, fintech, banking, FX, cards, spend management or financial infrastructure.

  • KYC, AML, Risk, Compliance or regulated customer operations.

  • Strategic or multi-entity customers across France and international markets.

  • Pre-sales, onboarding design or solution development.

  • Travel, E-commerce, SaaS, Technology or Professional Services.

The profile we are looking for

You are a hands-on manager who enjoys customer conversations, coaches through real situations and creates structure where processes are not yet mature. You combine customer empathy with commercial discipline, solve root causes rather than simply escalating issues, and turn customer insight into better team performance and repeatable growth.

This is not a pure support-management role, a purely strategic Customer Success role or a passive relationship-management position.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Als Content Creator bei amber arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle von Content, Produkt, Marketing und Recruiting. Du entwickelst Inhalte, die komplexe Themen rund um Business-KI verständlich, relevant und visuell ansprechend vermitteln.

Dabei verbindest du kreatives Handwerk mit strategischem Denken: Du erkennst relevante Themen, entwickelst daraus passende Formate und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Inhalte zu unseren Unternehmenszielen, unserer Marke und unserer Positionierung passen.

Du arbeitest eng mit Product, Marketing, Recruiting, Design und der Geschäftsführung zusammen.

Deine Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Konzeption, Produktion und Schnitt von Videos für Marketing, Recruiting, Produktkommunikation und weitere Unternehmensbereiche.

  • Entwicklung von Videoformaten, die unser Produkt, seine Funktionen und den konkreten Kundennutzen verständlich und überzeugend vermitteln.

  • Entwicklung einer strategischen Content-Roadmap sowie Priorisierung von Themen, Formaten und Kanälen.

  • Beobachtung relevanter Trends in Video, Social Media, Content Marketing und Business-KI sowie Übertragung geeigneter Impulse auf unsere Kommunikation.

  • Analyse der Performance veröffentlichter Inhalte und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung von Formaten und Vorgehensweisen.

  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von wiederverwendbaren Content-Prozessen, Vorlagen und Standards.

  • Sicherstellung eines konsistenten visuellen und sprachlichen Auftritts über alle Kanäle hinweg.

Deine Qualifikationen

  • Erfahrung als Content Creator, Video Producer, Video Editor, Social-Media-Manager oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle.

  • Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten in der Videoproduktion und im Videoschnitt – von der Ideenentwicklung über die Aufnahme bis zur finalen Bearbeitung.

  • Ein gutes Gespür für Storytelling, Dramaturgie, Bildsprache, Musik und Timing.

  • Erfahrung in der Erstellung von Video-Content für Marketing, Produktkommunikation, Recruiting oder Social Media.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit gängigen Tools für Videoschnitt, Motion Design, Audio- und Bildbearbeitung.

  • Die Fähigkeit, komplexe Inhalte schnell zu verstehen und auf den Punkt zu bringen.

  • Strategisches Denken und ein gutes Verständnis dafür, wie Content zu Marken-, Marketing- und Unternehmenszielen beiträgt.

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise sowie Freude daran, Ideen eigenverantwortlich umzusetzen.

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit und Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Teams und Stakeholdern.

  • Ein hohes Maß an Kreativität, Eigeninitiative und Qualitätsbewusstsein.

  • Erfahrung mit Social-Media-Plattformen und deren unterschiedlichen Content-Formaten ist ein Plus.

  • Interesse an KI, Unternehmenssoftware und digitalen Produkten

Benefits

  • Team Offsites - Da du in einem internationalen Team arbeiten wirst, treffen wir uns Zweimal im Jahr alle zusammen irgendwo in Europa

  • Du hast die Wahl: Entweder ein bezuschusstes Deutschlandticket oder eine Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft gehen auf uns

  • Wir leben ein Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Wir sind der Meinung, dass es wichtig ist regelmäßig in Person zusammenzuarbeiten. Darum treffen wir uns 3 mal wöchentlich an einem unserer Standorte

  • Damit Du vor Ort auch gut versorgt bist, gibt es bei uns jeden Arbeitstag vor Ort digitale, steuerfreie Essensgutscheine direkt aufs Handy

  • Attraktive Vergütung. Zusätzlich belohnen wir herausragende Mitarbeitende mit Unternehmensanteilen und lassen Sie so direkt am Unternehmenserfolg teilhaben

  • Starte in einem Unternehmen, das Dich wachsen lässt – egal, ob Du deine Skills in Deinem Bereich ausbauen oder andere Fähigkeiten erlernen möchtest

  • Wir fördern Deine persönliche Entwicklung durch Weiterbildung und Raum für Eigenverantwortung

  • Ein Team von motivierten Leuten, die Bock haben, KI-Lösungen auch für mittelständische Unternehmen zugänglich zu machen

  • Arbeite mit den neusten Technologien & Tools 🔨

 

Zum Schluss noch ein paar Worte

Bei amber hast du die Möglichkeit, mitzugestalten, wie Business-KI sichtbar, verständlich und erlebbar wird. Wir suchen jemanden, der kreative Ideen in hochwertige Inhalte übersetzt, strategisch denkt und Verantwortung von der ersten Idee bis zur Veröffentlichung übernimmt.

jobs.title: Account Executive/Sales (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Role

Hive Robotics is building Europe’s first full-stack orchestration platform for unmanned systems: connecting, controlling, and commanding multi-vendor drone and robot swarms. Our RF communication systems are Made in Germany, deployed on active frontlines, and targeting a highly valued tactical communication market with zero sovereign alternatives today.
As our first dedicated Account Executive, you own the sales pipeline: every opportunity from a lead to a signed contract. You take over our existing customer accounts and drive the opportunities our founders and Business Development have opened, with the first new deals expected to close within 3 months. You currently report to the CEO.
This role is customer-facing by design: expect 30–50% travel to customer sites, procurement offices, partners and trade fairs across Germany and Europe, sometimes internationally. The rest of the time you work alongside Engineering, Product Management and our Field Application Engineers.


Responsibilities

  • Own the funnel from the first qualified conversation to signature. Our founders and Business Development open doors with customers, partners and the wider ecosystem. From there the opportunity is yours: you qualify it, drive it and close it, pulling the founders back in only when a deal needs them. Leads you generate yourself count just as much, this isn't exclusively BD's territory.
  • Qualify hard and early. Run discovery against a fixed gate (pain, budget, decision-making unit, timing) before we invest engineering time in a technical deep dive, and keep a clear next step with a date on every opportunity.
  • Lead the customer's buying team through a hardware buying cycle: end users, engineers, procurement, legal and IT, across long evaluations, equipment trials run as projects, integration questions and security reviews.
  • Orchestrate the deal team. Bring in our engineers and Field Application Engineers for demos, trials and technical deep dives, and Product Management for configuration and fit. You decide when a deal needs them and what they're there to do.
  • Own our active customers commercially: account plans, follow-on orders, upsells and expansion into new units and use cases, every escalation that touches the relationship, and regular account reviews with the Field Application Engineer who owns adoption.
  • Turn deployed systems into the next deal: reference visits, customer quotes and case material that you or the founders can use to open new accounts.
  • Own the offer: configuration and pricing, terms and conditions, the cost-benefit case on the customer's own data, and the project plan to signature. Lead our responses to RFPs and tenders where they apply, and build the templates so every proposal starts from a proven base.
  • Get a trial agreement signed before any trial starts: scope, duration, success criteria, pilot price and the path to the main contract. You drive it, Operations owns the paperwork.
  • Close, and hand over cleanly. Request the contract from Operations, keep the customer and the internal side moving, and sign. Then hand over to Operations as a confirmed customer order and to the Field Application Engineer for onboarding.
  • Keep the pipeline honest: stage discipline, forecast and CRM hygiene, and a weekly pipeline review you run for the founders


Requirements

Must Have

  • 7+ years in B2B sales of technical products into complex, multi-stakeholder deals, ideally in a scale up company
  • You have sold hardware, or hardware combined with software and firmware: physical systems with configurations, lead times, integration work and delivery commitments behind them
  • Comfortable selling to technical and non-technical stakeholders in the same room, and knowing when to bring in the engineers
  • Hands-on daily work in a CRM and a disciplined qualification method (e.g. MEDDPICC): your forecast is something the company can plan on
  • Closer's mindset: you treat an opportunity without a next step and a date as a problem, not a pipeline entry
  • Structured working style: your offers, decisions and customer commitments are written down so that Operations, the field team and the founders can act on them without asking
  • Willingness to travel 30–50 % across Germany and Europe, occasionally beyond Europe
  • Fluent English (German is a very big plus)
  • Eligibility and willingness to undergo security vetting for access to some customer sites
Nice to Have
  • An existing network or experience selling to the DACH defense ecosystem: armed forces, procurement offices, primes, integrators
  • Technical fluency in RF communication, embedded systems, unmanned systems, command-and-control or robotics
  • Experience building a sales pipeline or sales function from scratch rather than inheriting one

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

The Role

Black Semiconductor GmbH is looking for a Technical Program Manager for a new product launch who will be responsible for overseeing the development and delivery of Application Specific Integrated Circuit (ASIC) programs combining electronics and photonics in advanced chiplet packages. The role involves leading and supporting cross-functional engineering teams, partnering closely with product management on scope and priorities, and coordinating external third-party IP and qualification providers to ensure the program meets time, technical, cost and quality targets.

As the Technical Program Manager, you will oversee the complete silicon and chiplet program cycle, from initial concept through implementation, validation, qualification, and final release to product — combining hands-on program management with enough technical fluency to catch integration and schedule risk before it becomes a crisis. You will drive program schedules, resolve technical and cross-functional issues, and lead the Program Core Team to align decisions, manage dependencies, and execute against milestones. This is a mid-level role: you'll take ownership of a defined program end-to-end rather than coordinating meetings for others, but you won't be expected to build program management infrastructure from the ground up on day one.

To join our team, you should be excited to

  • Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams and product management to set milestones, create integration plans, and address potential risks with mitigation strategies for next-generation chiplet products.

  • Develop schedules, identify critical paths and bottlenecks, and maintain execution throughout the duration of programs.

  • Coordinate the timely conception, development, and delivery of Application-Specific electronic and photonic integrated circuit programs, including multi-die/chiplet integration and known-good-die qualification.

  • Own the relationship with external third-party IP and qualification providers — tracking their deliverables against program milestones, running regular review cadences, and escalating risks before they hit the critical path.

  • Partner with product management to translate product requirements and priorities into an executable technical program plan, and keep both sides aligned as scope or schedule trade-offs come up.

  • Build and maintain strong working relationships and communicate effectively across multidisciplinary teams and leadership.

  • Manage chip delivery for development builds and ensure qualification to meet mass production schedules.

  • Serve as the primary point of accountability for program execution.

  • Ensure program documents are complete, up-to-date, and accessible.

  • Manage external suppliers more broadly. This includes allocating resources, establishing review processes, and coordinating with supply chain and operations.

Your Qualification

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of experience managing silicon, ASIC, IP, or photonics development programs, with proven ownership of semiconductor product lifecycles from concept through implementation, validation, qualification, and release.

  • Experience managing complex semiconductor programs involving external IP vendors, qualification providers, or test houses, ideally within chiplet, multi-die, or advanced packaging environments.

  • Strong ability to translate product requirements into executable technical plans, manage priorities and trade-offs, and drive execution through defined milestones, metrics, schedules, risks, and dependencies.

  • Experience leading cross-functional engineering teams and collaborating effectively with Product Management, suppliers, manufacturing partners, and external stakeholders.

  • Hands-on experience with ASIC/silicon development flows, chiplet/multi-die integration, qualification processes, PLM systems, risk management, change control, supplier coordination, and program tracking tools.

  • Strong communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work independently and within multidisciplinary teams.

  • Results-oriented, proactive, and self-motivated, with strong analytical, creative, and critical thinking skills.

  • Fluency in English is required; German language skills and Program Management certification are considered a plus.

  • Knowledge of semiconductor industry trends and disruptive technologies, including chiplet architectures and advanced packaging ecosystems, is considered a plus.

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

jobs.title: (Senior) DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented.


The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But International Fintechs and non-US banks are left with two unsatisfying options to access it: Either they build on legacy clearing banks that are slow and unreliable, or they interface with middleware providers that don’t move and hold the dollars directly, but themselves rely on underlying legacy banks. Augustus collapses this stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.


We are a group of operators, unicorn early employees, ex-founders and people who walked away from degrees because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and n8n.


We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.

The Role

You are DevOps Engineer #3. You join a Lead DevOps who has laid the groundwork - now you help scale it. You'll shape the infrastructure, automation, and reliability standards that let the entire engineering team ship faster and more safely.

You own big projects and drive them autonomously. You'll build and operate the platform that everything runs on - AWS infrastructure, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, observability, incident response, end to end. You work across engineering, security, and product to turn infrastructure into a competitive advantage. You design for failure, automate everything you can, and raise the bar for what production-grade means at a bank run by agents.

Your First Six Months

  • Months 1-2: You ramp up on the current infrastructure - how deployments work, where the rough edges are, what is automated and what is not. You pick up your first big project as an IC and start shipping. You pair with the Lead DevOps but operate independently from week one.

  • Months 3-4: You ship your first big project - for example, PR environment deployments or multi-region infrastructure. You scope the next project on the roadmap.

  • Months 5-6: You shape the infrastructure roadmap alongside the Lead DevOps. You scope, plan, and drive projects as the lead. You are the person the engineering team trusts to keep the platform fast, reliable, and safe.

Who Will Thrive At Augustus

We believe that throwing smart people with high agency at big problems produces the best outcomes. The people who succeed here share the following traits:

  • Relentless: You can't leave something broken. You don't stop because it got hard or because no one is watching.

  • Set The Bar: You're harder on yourself than anyone else would be. You don't need external accountability to care about quality.

  • Shape The Game: You don't wait for a playbook and you don't need one. You walke into genuinely new territory and figure it out. You move before anyone asked you to.

  • Systems First: You don't solve problems by adding people or effort. You build systems that make the problem smaller. Your first instinct is to automate, not to handle it manually.

This role is for you if:

  • You will write backend code, learn new tooling, or do whatever it takes to get the job done - you don't see anything as outside your lane.

  • You care as much about developer experience as you do about uptime.

  • Issues that block developers are your problems, not theirs.

  • You are excited about designing infrastructure for a bank that runs on agents, not on legacy systems.

  • You want to own the whole problem end to end, not a narrow slice of it.

This is not for you if:

  • You think DevOps means maintaining Jenkins and writing Helm charts.

  • You are a sysadmin by heart and do not step outside of infrastructure.

  • You need a well-defined scope handed to you before you can start.

  • You are not comfortable operating under banking-grade regulatory scrutiny.

  • You need a large team around you to be effective.

Hard Requirements

  • Experience: 4+ years in DevOps, SRE, Platform Engineering, or similar roles.

  • Cloud Fluency: Advanced hands-on experience with AWS (IAM, EC2, EKS, VPC, CloudWatch, etc.).

  • Kubernetes Mastery: Ability to design, debug, and operate production-grade Kubernetes environments.

  • IaC Expertise: Strong experience with Terraform (modules, workspaces, complex architectures).

  • Automation Mindset: Proficiency in Python, Go, or similar languages for automation and tooling.

  • CI/CD: Experience designing and maintaining GitHub Actions - or comparable CI/CD systems.

  • Observability: Familiarity with metrics, logging, distributed tracing, and incident response best practices.

  • Communication: You make complex infra concepts intuitive for developers and stakeholders.

jobs.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Editions, our network of delivery-only kitchens, is a key differentiator in France commercial ambition. The Account Management Lead – Editions France role is created as part of a wider reorganisation of the Editions business as part of our regional strategy. The role reports to Paris regional leadership and is designed to combine strategic partner leadership, P&L ownership and organisation building across the Editions network.

The Role

As Account Management Lead – Editions France, you will lead the Editions commercial team for France constituted of Senior Account Managers, Account Managers and Sales Managers. You will be the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, accountable for its coordination and its execution on the ground, growing the performance and profitability of our sites while driving occupancy and the differentiation Editions brings to the French market.

You will own a portion of the Editions P&L. That means holding the commercial scorecard for new kitchens, making financial decisions with a clear view of both partner and Deliveroo profitability, and steering your team's portfolio towards sustainable growth rather than volume alone.

You will be accountable for the development plan for your team, their success and learning curve at Deliveroo; setting the right KPIs and OKRs to monitor the business. Your role will be commercially focused, however Editions is as much a project management discipline as a commercial one: you will work hand in hand with Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction, Kitchen Layout, Site Operations, Marketing and the International Editions team to bring kitchens live and keep them performing.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Editions Strategy & Growth

    • Act as the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, ensuring its coordination across teams and its disciplined execution site by site

    • Lead your team's portfolio strategy, growing the performance and profitability of each Editions site in line with agreed targets

    • Develop the business so that it fits within, and contributes to, the wider regional strategy, bringing the specificity of the French network to regional and international forums

    • Build and deliver joint business plans with restaurant partners, identifying growth and profitability opportunities, defining mutual goals and finding compelling ways to solve them (menu optimisation, virtual brands, pricing, packaging, catchment expansion)

    • Coordinate with the Media team to identify and negotiate revenue opportunities to generate additional value from Editions sites

  • Occupancy & Commercial Performance

    • Own the occupancy trajectory of the French network, partnering closely with Local teams to positively drive occupancy and secure signed contracts within agreed timelines

    • Own and enforce the Editions commercial scorecard for new kitchens, profitability checks against P&L guidelines, launch package, site specificities, ensuring the process is applied consistently across the team

    • Steer the lead generation and pipeline process, mapping high-potential restaurants and cuisine gaps by site, and mobilising other commercial stakeholders to qualify interest

    • Lead commercial negotiations with business owners and C-suite operators, supporting proposals with a robust P&L rationale

  • P&L Ownership & Governance

    • Own a portion of the Editions P&L, accountable for revenue, profitability and the financial health of your perimeter

    • Set, own and deliver performance targets across occupancy, partner health, site profitability and Deliveroo output metrics

    • Run a clear operating rhythm on reporting, velocity, sign-to-live, occupancy and sales reviews, and use it to make decisions, not just to describe results

  • Kitchen Launches & Cross-functional Execution

  • Work with Site Managers, Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction and Kitchen Layout teams to secure the successful build and launch of new kitchens

  • Coordinate with Global team on kitchen implementation, and with Marketing and Operations on launch packages, so that every opening lands on time and performs from week one

  • Manage and oversee project execution end to end, including B2B communication and cross-business-unit workshops

  • Propose process optimisation and automation: Deliveroo moves fast, and you will improve the processes that let Editions scale

  • Senior Stakeholder Management

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (f/d/m)
jobs.description:
A definitive shift is currently happening. Corporates across the globe are no longer just reporting on sustainability; they are actively investing in it as a core financial and strategic asset.

At CEEZER, we are architecting the infrastructure for enterprise-grade Climate Performance Asset management, transforming how the world's largest companies source and manage carbon credits, Energy Attribution Certificates (EAC), and Sustainable Aviation Fuel certificates (SAFc).

Our platform gives the world’s most ambitious enterprises the data-driven precision, real-time monitoring, and framework-compliant reporting required to confidently deploy capital toward high-impact Climate Performance Asset portfolios and true, measurable climate action.

We are looking for a Customer Success Manager to join our team. Moving beyond traditional account management, this role requires an operational partner to drive post-transaction delivery, manage cross-functional workflows, and convert front-line client insights into scalable sales enablement. You will combine high-touch client support with rigorous execution to ensure enterprise buyers experience seamless value at every stage.

The Role

  • Manage end-to-end post-transaction execution, serving as the primary liaison for clients on retirement coordination, custom reporting requests, and finance operations including invoicing queries.

  • Proactively identify supply delays and operational risks, developing swift mitigation strategies and partnering with Account Executives to deliver clear, solutions-focused client communications.

  • Maintain rigorous data hygiene across Salesforce and our platform while systematically uncovering expansion and upsell opportunities to drive recurring account growth alongside Sales.

  • Deliver high-touch client support and troubleshooting, rallying internal cross-functional teams to streamline deliverable timelines and ensure seamless execution.

  • Synthesize front-line client feedback to inform product roadmaps, while translating real-world best practices into enablement resources that prepare Account Executives for pre-sales conversations.

  • Partner with Sales and Marketing to execute strategic client communication campaigns that keep complex corporate networks, suppliers, and subsidiaries engaged long-term.


Requirements

  • 2–7 years of experience in client-facing operations, enterprise account management, or B2B customer success, with a track record of driving flawless post-transaction execution.

  • Exceptional project management capabilities and operational discipline, with the proven ability to structure complex deliverables and manage a broad, dynamic scope of responsibility.

  • Highly analytical mindset with a strong command of data and reporting, capable of translating complex metrics into polished, reusable client-facing assets and frameworks.

  • Polished verbal and written communication skills, with the executive presence required to confidently engage and align senior external stakeholders.

  • Operational proficiency with Salesforce and modern CRM architecture to maintain rigorous data alignment across client management platforms.

  • Fluency in German is a plus, alongside a foundational understanding of carbon markets, sustainability regulations, or evolving corporate climate frameworks.

What's in it for you at CEEZER?

  • A mission that matters: Work alongside international teams combining finance, tech, and climate science professionals to direct capital toward the world's most critical climate assets.

  • Accelerated growth: We are scaling fast, and your career will too. Take opportunities to lead cross-functional initiatives and expand your strategic influence.

  • True ownership: We are building in a brand-new market, meaning many of our best practices don’t exist yet. If you see a better workflow, tool, or strategy, you have the autonomy and backing to build it.

  • An empowering environment: We bring together diverse global perspectives, knowing that solving complex climate challenges requires a wide mix of backgrounds and expertise.

  • Real enterprise impact: Transform how global corporates approach sustainability. CEEZER hosts 50Mt+ of vetted carbon credits across all pathways, all backed by sophisticated data and institutional-grade risk management.

  • A net-zero career: We practice what we preach. From your first day, we fully offset your personal and professional carbon footprint because sustainability is how we operate.

 

Create an impact with us?

We know that great talent doesn’t always follow a linear path. If your experience doesn't check every single box on this list, but you have the drive and unique strengths to excel here, we still want to hear from you.

Here, building a diverse team isn't a checkbox—It’s how we solve complex global challenges. We make all hiring decisions based on merit, skills, and potential, while actively working to keep unconscious bias out of our process. We’ve created an environment where all individuals feel valued and empowered to succeed. We welcome diverse applicants and are dedicated to providing equal opportunities for everyone to thrive.

If you need any adjustments or specific accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know. We are here to support you.

About us

CEEZER is the leading partner for Climate Performance Asset procurement and management, empowering businesses to transform climate ambition into a clear path to net-zero. Trusted by major organizations including Deutsche Telekom, LGT, and Nasdaq, CEEZER provides the confidence needed to implement effective climate action strategies. For more information, visit ceezer.earth.

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page.
