jobs.title: Account Executive (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Your mission

At Bliq, we are building and launching driverless vehicles for everyday life and business operations across Europe.

We are looking for a Account Executive to help bring them to customers.

You will acquire business and individual customers across European markets and own the commercial process end-to-end: identify and engage prospects, run discovery, demonstrate the product in person, design the right commercial and operating model for each customer, build proposals, negotiate, and close.

Our customers can look very different. One week, you may be discussing a fleet deployment with a taxi or car-sharing company. The next, you may be showing the vehicle to a real-estate company, law firm, mobility operator, or prospective individual customer.

This is not a role where you inherit a mature market, established category, and optimized sales playbook. Driverless technology is only getting started in Europe. You will need to understand unfamiliar customer problems quickly, figure out how Bliq can solve them, and help us discover how this technology should be sold.

You will work closely with the Commercial Lead and founders to refine Bliq’s sales playbook market by market.

Responsibilities

  • Own the sales cycle from first conversation through signed contract

  • Build pipeline through targeted outbound and proactive prospecting across European markets

  • Run sharp discovery conversations that uncover customer operations, economics, pain points, and decision criteria

  • Conduct live Bliq vehicle demos and turn the experience into a compelling commercial conversation

  • Develop deployment concepts together with prospects, including use case, fleet size, operating model, responsibilities, economics, and rollout plan

  • Create proposals, commercial models, LOIs, and contracts together with the relevant internal teams

  • Navigate complex buying processes involving operators, management teams, fleet owners, partners, and other stakeholders

  • Build relationships with customers across mobility, taxi, car sharing, rental, real estate, professional services, and other relevant sectors

  • Own defined markets and be accountable for commercial progress within them

  • Keep CRM data, pipeline, next steps, and forecasts accurate

  • Test new segments, messages, channels, and commercial models and turn what works into repeatable processes

  • Work closely with the Customer Deployment team to make sure signed customers can actually be deployed successfully

  • Represent Bliq at customer meetings, industry events, demos, and market visits across Europe

  • Support B2C sales initiatives when they become part of the GTM strategy

  • Bring customer feedback directly into Bliq’s product, operations, and commercial decisions



Your profile

Apply if this describes you:

  • You have at least 2 years of Account Executive or comparable full-cycle sales experience

  • You are a hunter and enjoy creating opportunities rather than waiting for inbound demand

  • You learn quickly and can become credible on a complex technical product without hiding behind technical jargon

  • You are excellent face-to-face and comfortable walking into an important customer meeting, running the room, and demonstrating a physical product

  • You are customer-first and care about finding solutions that make customers satisfied

  • You have strong commercial judgment and understand how to turn customer needs into a viable deal

  • You write clearly and can produce concise, convincing emails, proposals, and commercial documents

  • You are highly organized and detail-oriented; pipeline hygiene, follow-ups, and commitments do not get lost

  • You have CRM experience and understand disciplined sales processes

  • Experience with tools such as Clay, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar is a plus

  • You know how to use AI to research, prepare, analyze, and move faster while keeping the thinking and customer judgment your own

  • You have a figure-it-out mindset and remain effective when there is no existing template for the problem

  • You are comfortable owning a market or commercial project and being measured by the outcome

  • You can work professionally in German and English; additional European languages are a plus

  • You are based in Berlin

  • You are willing to travel regularly across Europe

  • Experience selling hardware, mobility, automotive, physical technology, or other operationally complex products is a strong plus

This role will probably not suit you if you want an established sales process, a narrowly defined territory, a predictable product demo, or a manager telling you exactly what to do next.

It will suit you if you want to help create a category, sell something people can experience in the real world, and build the commercial machine while running it.


Why us?

  • Sell a product people are excited about

  • Build Bliq’s sales playbook together with the Commercial Lead

  • Work directly with the founders and senior team

  • Own meaningful customer relationships and markets from an early stage

  • Work on complex deals combining technology, vehicles, operations, economics, and regulation

  • See deals move from your first message to vehicles operating on public roads with the customer

  • Fast decisions, direct feedback, and no bureaucracy

  • Strong compensation package with meaningful upside for performance

  • Significant room to grow as Bliq expands across European markets

Tips for a successful application

  1. Show us that you can sell. Generic applications tell us very little.

  2. Tell us what you have personally owned and what results you produced.

  3. If you have built pipeline, opened a new market, sold a difficult product, or closed an unusual deal, tell us how.

  4. Use AI as a tool. Make sure the thinking and personality in your application are yours.

If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

As a member of our AI model team, you will drive innovation in model serving and inference architectures for advanced AI systems. Your work will focus on optimizing model deployment and inference strategies to deliver highly responsive, efficient, and scalable performance across real-world applications. You will work on a wide spectrum of systems, ranging from resource-efficient models designed for limited hardware environments to complex, multi-modal architectures that integrate data such as text, images, and audio.

We expect you to have deep expertise in designing and optimizing model serving pipelines and inference frameworks as well as a strong background in advanced model architectures. You will adopt a hands-on, research-driven approach to develop, test, and implement novel serving strategies and inference algorithms. Your responsibilities include engineering robust inference pipelines, establishing comprehensive performance metrics, and identifying and resolving bottlenecks in production environments. The ultimate goal is to enable high-throughput, low-latency, low-memory footprint, and scalable AI performance that delivers tangible value in dynamic, real-world scenarios.

Responsibilities

  • Design and deploy state-of-the-art model serving architectures that deliver high throughput and low latency while optimizing memory usage. Ensure these pipelines run efficiently across diverse environments, including resource-constrained devices and edge platforms. Establish clear performance targets such as reduced latency, improved token response, and minimized memory footprint.

  • Build, run, and monitor controlled inference tests in both simulated and live production environments. Track key performance indicators such as response latency, throughput, memory consumption, and error rates, with special attention to metrics specific to resource-constrained devices. Document iterative results and compare outcomes against established benchmarks to validate performance across platforms.

  • Identify and prepare high-quality test datasets and simulation scenarios tailored to real-world deployment challenges, specifically those encountered on low-resource devices. Set measurable criteria to ensure that these resources effectively evaluate model performance, latency, and memory utilization under various operational conditions.

  • Analyze computational efficiency and diagnose bottlenecks in the serving pipeline by monitoring both processing and memory metrics. Address issues such as suboptimal batch processing, network delays, and high memory usage to optimize the serving infrastructure for scalability and reliability on resource-constrained systems.

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to integrate optimized serving and inference frameworks into production pipelines designed for edge and on-device applications. Define clear success metrics such as improved real-world performance, low error rates, robust scalability, optimal memory usage and ensure continuous monitoring and iterative refinements for sustained improvements.


  • A degree in Computer Science  or related field. Ideally PhD in NLP, Machine Learning, or a related field, complemented by a solid track record in AI R&D (with good publications in A* conferences).

  • Must have knowledge of Metal Shading Language (MSL). You should be comfortable writing custom compute shaders from scratch.

  • Proven experience in low-level kernel optimizations and inference optimization on mobile devices is essential. Your contributions should have led to measurable improvements in inference latency, throughput, and memory footprint for domain-specific applications, particularly on resource-constrained devices and edge platforms.

  • A deep understanding of modern model serving architectures and inference optimization techniques is required. This includes state-of-the-art methods for achieving low-latency, high-throughput performance, and efficient memory management in diverse, resource-constrained deployment scenarios.

  • Must have strong expertise in writing GPU kernels for mobile devices (i.e., smartphones) as well as a deep understanding of model serving frameworks and engines. Practical experience in developing and deploying end-to-end inference pipelines, from optimizing models for efficient serving to integrating these solutions on resource-constrained devices is required. 

  • Demonstrated ability to apply empirical research to overcome challenges in model serving, such as latency optimization, computational bottlenecks, and memory constraints. You should be proficient in designing robust evaluation frameworks and iterating on optimization strategies to continuously push the boundaries of inference performance and system efficiency.

  • Distributed Inference Systems: Designing and optimizing high-performance inference engines using techniques like Tensor Parallelism, Pipeline Parallelism, and Expert Parallelism to handle massive models on GPU clusters.

  • Deep understanding of the math and structure behind Diffusion Models and Vision Transformers

  • Understanding of Pruning, Quantization, Flash attention, KV Cache, Speculative Decoding (Eagle) etc.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

This is a role for someone who enjoys both the legal and operational sides of the job: not simply answering questions, but building the frameworks, processes and decision-making structures that prevent the same questions from coming up repeatedly.

What you'll do

  • Own corporate governance across our German GmbH and US entity: shareholder and board matters, financing rounds, related-party and conflict-of-interest questions.

  • Lead commercial contracting across hardware sales, licensing, research collaborations, cloud and service agreements, and NDAs. Build the templates and playbook so that standard cases can be handled efficiently.

  • Take ownership of export control and dual-use matters, including EU Dual-Use Regulation, German licensing requirements, US export-control exposure, sanctions and restricted-party screening.

  • Lead our cybersecurity and product compliance agenda, including NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act and related incident-reporting and conformity requirements.

  • Cover product safety and market access for the hardware itself, including CE marking, EMC, RoHS, REACH and product liability.

  • Manage our IP portfolio: patents, freedom to operate, trade secrets, licensing, technology rights and trademarks.

  • Manage compliance obligations connected to public funding, including grant conditions, record keeping and audit readiness.

  • Work with People & Culture on employment matters, including contracts, terminations, employee participation structures, immigration. Data protection and GDPR sit here too.

  • Oversee open-source licence compliance and software supply-chain obligations together with engineering.

  • Build the delegation layer: signing authority, approval thresholds, decision rights and clear ownership, so that routine hiring, procurement and commercial decisions do not automatically converge on the managing directors.

  • Decide what we keep in house and what goes to external counsel, then manage those firms and the associated budget.

About You

You are comfortable being the only lawyer in the building, and you see that as an opportunity rather than a risk. You enjoy the operational side of legal work as much as the technical side.

You are direct, commercially minded and comfortable making judgement calls. You know where your own limits are and are happy to bring in specialists when the question warrants it.

  • Qualified German lawyer (Volljurist), with fluency in EU regulation.

  • In-house experience at a semiconductor, hardware or deep-tech company, ideally in a start-up or scale-up environment rather than exclusively in a large corporate legal department is strongly preferred.

  • Experience with export control and dual-use questions in a business that actually ships internationally, including an understanding of the difference between licensing and per-transaction screening.

  • Comfortable across a wide surface: corporate, commercial, IP, employment and regulatory. You do not need to be the deepest expert in each area, but you need to know what good looks like and when to escalate.

  • You have built structure inside a company before: templates, approval frameworks, signing authority or something equivalent that outlived your involvement.

  • Familiarity with hardware product regulation, CE marking, RoHS and REACH, or with the evolving EU cybersecurity regime is a strong plus.

  • German and English at working fluency, both written and spoken.

  • Based in or willing to relocate to the company's location in either Dresden or Berlin.

Why Join

You would be shaping the legal function of a company with direct access to the managing directors.

The subject matter is unusually interesting: brain-inspired computing, advanced hardware, international technology sales, export-controlled technology, research partnerships and a regulatory environment that is evolving in real time.

The work environment is flexible and inclusive, and we offer a competitive salary with relocation support for the right person. If you want to build something meaningful rather than maintain something that already exists, this is that kind of role.

jobs.description:
Vertrauensvertrieb an Banken, Versicherer und Versorger – kein Verkauf über die eigene Person. Einstieg in Voll- oder Teilzeit, mit dem Ziel, das gesamte Neugeschäft zu verantworten.

Wir suchen keine schnellen Abschlüsse. Wir suchen die Person, die unser Neugeschäft in einigen Jahren führt und heute anfängt, sich das zu erarbeiten.

Seit 2008 entwickeln wir digitale Sponsoringformate für Banken, Versicherungen und Energieversorger. Mit vielen Kunden arbeiten wir seit Jahren zusammen, mit einigen seit über einem Jahrzehnt.

Aufgaben

Worum es geht

Kunden kommen zu uns, weil wir ihr Haus verstehen und entsprechend beraten. Bisher kam diese Beratung vor allem vom Geschäftsführer. Genau diesen Teil des Geschäfts geben wir jetzt Schritt für Schritt ab.

Du übernimmst ihn nicht über Nacht. Zu Beginn arbeitest du eng mit unserem Geschäftsführer zusammen und lernst die Beziehungen kennen, auf denen dieses Geschäft ruht. Mit der Zeit führst du sie selbst, und dein Ziel ist, über die Jahre das gesamte Neugeschäft zu verantworten und deutlich zu vergrößern. Wir suchen jemanden, der genau das sucht: nicht eine Rolle ausfüllen, sondern eine aufbauen.

Warum das anspruchsvoll ist

Vom ersten Kontakt bis zum ersten Auftrag vergehen Monate und viele Gespräche. Aufträge entstehen über Vertrauen, Fachlichkeit und Empfehlung, nie über Druck. Deine erste Anlaufstelle sitzt meist im Marketing, in der Kommunikation oder im Vorstandsstab. Du verstehst, wie in solchen Häusern tatsächlich entschieden wird, gewinnst die Menschen, die deinen Fall intern vertreten, und führst ihn durch die Gremien, bis aus Interesse ein Auftrag wird.

Deine Gesprächspartner sind erfahren und erkennen sofort, wenn jemand nur Verkaufsrhetorik abspult. Wir verkaufen nicht über die Person, die vorn steht, sondern über die Sichtbarkeit und Fachlichkeit, aus der Vertrauen wächst. Genau die baust du mit auf. Nicht jede Anfrage trägt sofort. Wer dranbleibt, gewinnt hier.

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringst

  • Den Ehrgeiz, dieses Geschäft eines Tages allein zu führen. Diese Aussicht reizt dich, statt dich zu erschrecken.
  • Ein feines Gespür für Sprache und für Zahlen.
  • Sicherheit im Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Funktionen, vom Marketing bis zum Vorstandsstab. Du durchschaust ihre internen Abläufe und findest die Kompromisse, die einen Auftrag intern tragfähig machen.
  • Den Blick für Branchenentwicklungen, aus denen du konkrete Kommunikationschancen für unsere Kunden ableitest.
  • Die Fähigkeit, aus Ansprache und Formaten Sichtbarkeit zu bauen, die Vertrauen schafft, und dich am Ergebnis zu messen.
  • Erste einschlägige Erfahrung. Wichtiger als die Jahre ist uns, dass du lange Entscheidungswege aushältst und nach vorn willst.

Von Vorteil

  • Erfahrung aus dem Agentur-, Beratungs- oder institutionellen Umfeld (Banken, Versicherer, öffentliche Hand).
  • Erfahrung mit Kunden und langen Entscheidungswegen in großen Organisationen.
  • Verhandlungssicheres Englisch, schriftlich wie im Gespräch.

Benefits

Was du bei uns findest

Du beginnst nicht auf einem leeren Blatt. Unser Geschäftsführer öffnet dir den Zugang zu einem Netzwerk und einem Marktverständnis, die über Jahre gewachsen sind, und zieht sich in dem Maß zurück, in dem du Verantwortung übernimmst. Der Weg führt bis zur vollen Verantwortung für das Neugeschäft. Das ist das erklärte Ziel dieser Position, keine Aussicht zur Zier. Deine Arbeit ermöglicht digitale Mitmachformate mit gesellschaftlicher Wirkung. Einstieg in Teil- oder Vollzeit mit überwiegendem Präsenzanteil für den engen Austausch mit dem Team.

Interesse?

Bewirb dich mit deinem Lebenslauf. Ein förmliches Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Und bitte erzähl uns nicht, dass du verkaufen kannst. Beantworte uns lieber gleich zwei Fragen, sonst sprechen wir im ersten Gespräch darüber:

  • Erzähl uns von einem Kundenprojekt, um das du lange gerungen hast, und was du daraus gelernt hast.
  • Wie stellst du dir deine Einarbeitung vor, und wo würdest du selbst anfangen?

Schick deine Bewerbung samt Gehaltsvorstellung an .
